open_points.subject: execute_function and judge_execution
open_points.text: It reads at most eight times bounds.output_bytes plus 1 048 576 bytes (room for base64, JSON escaping, trap lines and the failure); when the runner writes more it stops reading, kills the environment as for its wall deadline, decodes what it read and observes channel_over_bound, so the execution concludes resource_exhausted.
open_points.other_text: A bound counts as hit only when the parent observes it — the report's resource_hit, the observation's channel_over_bound or that count over bounds.output_bytes; the parent kills an environment for its wall deadline alone (owner, 2026-10-06).
open_points.question: Must the parent kill the environment when the channel exceeds its bound, or may it kill an environment only for its wall deadline?
